overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation, because a member's post on a town-wide social media forum was directed to the general public and no other member responded.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a Committee member deliberated via social media about matters that will come before the Committee.
allegations.key_passage: Where, as here, a member of a public body posts on a town-wide social media forum in a manner that is directed to the general public and no other member of the public body responds, we do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
